description: REQUIRES prior efine__session__login call with same account_link_id. Read-only. Lists administrative fines already paid. Set all_period true for everything, or false and give a range of at most three months. Paying, printing and per-row detail are not offered. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

all_period.description: True reads every period. Do not send date_from or date_to with it - a range is rejected.

date_from.description: Optional. Range start as YYYY-MM-DD. YYYYMMDD is rejected.

date_to.description: Optional. Range end as YYYY-MM-DD, at most three months after date_from. YYYYMMDD is rejected.

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

page_size.description: Optional. Rows per page as the institution offers them.

vehicle_number.description: Optional. Narrows the list to one vehicle.
